verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Git Sync stores project data, including collections, scripts and tests, directly in any third-party Git repository, which gives git-based versioning of automations. AI commit-message suggestions support clean history, and an in-app merge view lets you review and resolve conflicts. Rollback is only implied by the Git backing; the docs never show reverting or restoring a prior version, and review is limited to conflict merging rather than a diff or approval workflow. Missing for 10: documented rollback/restore of prior versions, in-app diff or change-review workflow beyond conflict merging, independent or hands-on corroboration.
